p_fraud, sens, fpr = 0.005, 0.95, 0.02
p_flag = (sens * p_fraud
          + fpr * (1 - p_fraud))
post = sens * p_fraud / p_flag

# p_flag = 0.02465
# post   = 0.1927
caption: Only about 19% of flags are real fraud.

code:
100,000 transactions
    500 fraud  -> 475 flagged
 99,500 legit  -> 1,990 flagged

flagged total = 2,465
real fraud    = 475 / 2,465
              = 19.3%
caption: A small false-positive rate times a big majority.

rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
fraud = rng.random(n) < 0.005
flag = np.where(fraud,
    rng.random(n) < 0.95,
    rng.random(n) < 0.02)
fraud[flag].mean()   # 0.1921
caption: n = 2,000,000 simulated transactions.
